statusDetail: Public, pre-auth representative templates audited. Account opening was inspected to the credential boundary; regulated KYC/trading after authentication was intentionally outside public-scope coverage.

page.notes: Server-rendered public content with client hydration, shared desktop-oriented global shell, manifest but no active service worker registration.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot under emulated prefers-color-scheme: dark and computed root theme inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains white and the rendered root is data-theme="light" with color-scheme:light.

checkOutcomes.method: getAnimations() under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce
checkOutcomes.evidence: The preference matched, but five animations remained, including four indefinitely running 30s–200s animations, and no reduced-motion CSS rule was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Screenshot under forced-colors: active plus Lighthouse contrast inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Forced-colors rendered navigation, search, and ticker text visibly in system black/white colors; ordinary-mode contrast failures are recorded separately under sufficient-contrast.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered CSS probe and route walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The browser supports View Transitions, but no view-transition CSS was present on any representative template and route changes use abrupt full swaps.

checkOutcomes.method: CSS feature probe and long-task/animation inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: No scrollytelling, parallax, or scroll-linked reveal was observed on the representative pages, so no main-thread scroll-linked animation anti-pattern was found.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No gesture-driven removal, pull-to-reveal, draggable carousel, or comparable physical gesture was present on the audited public templates.
checkOutcomes.reason: No gesture-driven removal, pull-to-reveal, draggable carousel, or comparable physical gesture was present on the audited public templates.

checkOutcomes.method: Mobile screenshots and CSS feature probe across long pages
checkOutcomes.evidence: Long pages retain a clipped desktop-style header and provide no progress or scroll-state adaptation; no scroll-state/container CSS was detected.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No open tooltip, popover, or edge-sensitive anchored menu was exposed in the representative public flows.
checkOutcomes.reason: No open tooltip, popover, or edge-sensitive anchored menu was exposed in the representative public flows.

checkOutcomes.method: Route walkthrough and rendered CSS probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: Route changes and the 404-to-home path provide no directional transition or focus/attention cue; view-transition/highlight styles were absent.

checkOutcomes.method: Load screenshot and fixed-overlay DOM probe on account-opening route
checkOutcomes.evidence: The demat route opens with a viewport-covering signup overlay before interaction and no visible close action.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM semantics probe of the signup overlay
checkOutcomes.evidence: The covering signup modal is a fixed DIV (.rodal) with no dialog role; representative pages reported zero <dialog> and zero popover elements.

checkOutcomes.method: Desktop and mobile visual review
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home, stock detail, calculator, and blog templates use restrained borders and keep their primary content visually dominant once no overlay is present.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout primitive at 360x800/390x844 on seven templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Every sampled template overflowed horizontally: home/stocks/mutual funds by about 6.7k px, stock detail by 442 px, calculator by 384 px, demat by 347 px, and blog by 682 px.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered stylesheet probe across seven templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: No @container rules were found, while shared header/ticker and cards visibly remain desktop-sized and clipped at mobile widths.

checkOutcomes.method: Interactive-target and focus probes across templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Each template exposes more than 400 visible targets below 24px in at least one dimension; sampled pre-rendered anchors did not accept focus or show an outline.

checkOutcomes.method: First-viewport screenshots and heading/CTA inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home, stocks, mutual funds, stock detail, calculator, and blog all state their purpose with a clear H1 and an obvious next action or content object.

checkOutcomes.method: Public pre-auth task walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The representative public flow, open SIP calculator, adjust investment/return/time inputs, and read updated totals, was available without a dead end; investment/account execution correctly requires authentication.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid-route walkthrough plus delayed-price state inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The stock detail explains delayed prices and offers LOGIN; an invalid route renders a clear 404 with a Go to Home Page recovery link.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse plus DevTools trace
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 10.6s, TBT 7,020ms and performance 0.33; trace corroborated LCP 2.44s and 445ms TBT in a lighter desktop run.

checkOutcomes.method: Layout observer and Lighthouse CLS
checkOutcomes.evidence: Both the mobile layout observer and Lighthouse recorded CLS 0 on the home load.

checkOutcomes.method: DevTools trace, layout long-task observer, and Lighthouse
checkOutcomes.evidence: Trace recorded 9 long tasks (longest 232ms, TBT 445ms); mobile Lighthouse measured 7,020ms TBT.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR summary confirmed against DOM and Lighthouse insights
checkOutcomes.evidence: Home loaded 360 requests and 4.14MB transferred, including 138 scripts; Lighthouse failed LCP discovery and network-dependency insights.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse code coverage and HAR weight analysis
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 776KiB unused JS and 16KiB unused CSS; analytics and app chunks dominate the request weight.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse accessibility plus DOM probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Lighthouse found an accessible-name mismatch; calculator has three unlabeled inputs, the account overlay input has no label/ARIA name, and image audit found two missing alt attributes.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse color-contrast audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Ticker text measured 2.51:1, positive values 2.66:1, and the white-on-green Get started control 2.66:1, below WCAG AA.

checkOutcomes.method: Landmark and focus probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Representative probes found no main/nav/header/footer landmarks, while sampled links had outline-style none and many empty accessible names, making focus orientation unreliable.

checkOutcomes.method: Visual review of content templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Primary headings and body text on stock, calculator, and blog templates are comfortably sized and not clipped vertically.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse viewport audit and mobile layout/target probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse found a second viewport declaration with maximum-scale=1/user-scalable=no; every template overflowed horizontally and hundreds of targets were under 24px.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse Runtime/console collection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Console logged FedCM concurrency/network errors and multiple CSP-blocked scripts, images, and analytics requests.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM, Lighthouse, and image audit
checkOutcomes.evidence: Doctype/charset are valid, but 4 images lack dimensions, 29 are oversized, 18 use legacy formats, and 2 lack alt text.

checkOutcomes.method: Lighthouse best-practices diagnostics
checkOutcomes.evidence: The page failed BFCache for three no-store reasons, emitted inspector issues, and large first-party bundles referenced missing source maps.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM metadata probes on seven templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Every representative page had a unique descriptive title and meta description.

checkOutcomes.method: Anchor, viewport, robots, and Lighthouse probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: URLs and robots are crawlable, but 326–330 anchors per template have no descriptive text/accessible name, and mobile Lighthouse found zoom disabled by a second viewport meta.

checkOutcomes.method: Canonical/robots probes and robots/sitemap fetch
checkOutcomes.evidence: All sampled pages returned index signals and self-referential canonicals; robots.txt and sitemap.xml were reachable.

checkOutcomes.method: JSON-LD and Open Graph probe across templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: All sampled entity/content templates exposed 2–4 JSON-LD blocks and seven Open Graph tags consistent with visible titles.

checkOutcomes.method: Headers, cookies, and Lighthouse security inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff/frame protection are present, but the desktop response lacked CSP, 7 of 8 cookies were flagged insecure, and the mobile CSP blocked several configured integrations.

checkOutcomes.method: Tracker primitive and HAR summary
checkOutcomes.evidence: Load contacted 14 third-party origins including four known trackers; HAR captured 347 third-party-classified requests and 4.07MB transferred (including first-party asset subdomains classified by origin).

checkOutcomes.method: Load inspection and authentication-overlay review
checkOutcomes.evidence: No browser permission prompt appeared on load; authentication offers Google FedCM and an email continuation rather than exposing a password-only form.

checkOutcomes.method: Security-header primitive and Lighthouse CSP inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; desktop CSP was absent while mobile CSP produced blocked-resource violations, indicating inconsistent defensive policy deployment.

checkOutcomes.method: Discoverability raw-HTML/no-JS comparison on seven templates
checkOutcomes.evidence: Raw HTML retained 85–99% of rendered content on every template and none was a JS shell, so core public content remains reachable without JavaScript.

checkOutcomes.method: Representative route, overlay, and calculator walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: Stock data, calculator, signup overlay, and blog all reached stable rendered states; no cut-off menu or broken asynchronous shell was observed beyond separately reported reflow.

checkOutcomes.method: Manifest fetch and service-worker registration probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: A valid standalone manifest exists, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registration, so the app has no demonstrated offline fallback.

checkOutcomes.method: Invalid-route request and screenshot
checkOutcomes.evidence: An invalid URL renders an intentional, readable 404 state with a direct home recovery action instead of a blank shell.

checkOutcomes.method: DOM language/direction and representative-layout probes
checkOutcomes.evidence: Pages declare lang=en but no dir; the public site claims multilingual finance yet exposes no hreflang/language choice in sampled metadata, and severe fixed-width overflow gives no evidence that translated expansion or bidi layouts survive.

checkOutcomes.method: Rendered currency/number inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Calculator and stock templates consistently render Indian currency and lakh grouping (for example ₹30,00,000 and ₹335.60), appropriate for the stated Indian locale.

checkOutcomes.method: Recon and applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No public audited template exposed a date/time scheduling or recurring-event workflow whose time-zone or DST behavior could apply.
checkOutcomes.reason: No public audited template exposed a date/time scheduling or recurring-event workflow whose time-zone or DST behavior could apply.

checkOutcomes.method: Account-opening load screenshot and overlay DOM probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The demat route forces an undismissible full-screen signup DIV before users can inspect the page; there is no visible cancel/close affordance and consent copy is compressed into the continuation UI.

checkOutcomes.method: Signup and calculator form semantics inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup control is not a semantic form, its text input is unlabeled, and no accessible error-announcement surface or declarative validation semantics were present.

checkOutcomes.method: Input autocomplete/label probe
checkOutcomes.evidence: The signup field has autocomplete="on" instead of a purpose-specific email token and no label/ARIA name; three calculator inputs are also unlabeled.

checkOutcomes.method: Pre-auth account-opening walkthrough
checkOutcomes.evidence: The account route immediately traps the page behind a modal-like signup layer with no visible cancellation, weakening reversibility before the user can review account details.

checkOutcomes.method: Image primitive and HAR inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: 29 of 31 images were over 2x displayed resolution, 18 used legacy formats, 7 lacked srcset, and 26 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded.

checkOutcomes.method: HAR, trace, and Lighthouse coverage
checkOutcomes.evidence: The home load makes 360 requests with 138 scripts; Lighthouse estimated 776KiB unused JS and the trace recorded nine long tasks.

checkOutcomes.method: Tracker and HAR budget inspection
checkOutcomes.evidence: Known ad/analytics trackers and WebEngage contribute hundreds of kilobytes; Google Tag Manager/gtag alone account for roughly 487KB transferred.

checkOutcomes.method: Runtime agent-capability probe and contextual applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No agent-facing capability is claimed by the public site, and the runtime probe found no WebMCP registration; this emerging capability is contextual and therefore not penalised.
checkOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability is claimed by the public site, and the runtime probe found no WebMCP registration; this emerging capability is contextual and therefore not penalised.

checkOutcomes.method: Runtime built-in-AI probe and contextual applicability judgement
checkOutcomes.evidence: No summarisation or language-model experience is offered on the audited public templates, so on-device inference is not applicable.
checkOutcomes.reason: No summarisation or language-model experience is offered on the audited public templates, so on-device inference is not applicable.

checkOutcomes.method: Baseline and post-interaction heap snapshots around ten calculator range-update cycles
checkOutcomes.evidence: After ten representative calculator updates, node count fell from 833,097 to 831,736 and self size from 49,888,433 to 49,813,933 bytes; no retained growth was observed.

checkOutcomes.method: Heap summary totals on the calculator template
checkOutcomes.evidence: A simple calculator retained about 833k heap nodes and 49.9MB self size at baseline, a large footprint for this surface even though it did not grow under repetition.

checkOutcomes.method: Before/after heap totals over repeated interaction
checkOutcomes.evidence: The repeated interaction ended with 1,361 fewer heap nodes and 74,500 fewer self-size bytes than baseline, providing no signal of accumulating detached DOM/listeners in this bounded test.

principleOutcomes.reason: No agent-facing capability is claimed by the public site, and the runtime probe found no WebMCP registration; this emerging capability is contextual and therefore not penalised. No summarisation or language-model experience is offered on the audited public templates, so on-device inference is not applicable.

paths.description: Homepage and global shell; represents product discovery, navigation, preference, performance, privacy, and metadata behavior.
Stocks landing/listing archetype; represents category discovery and shared long-form product marketing template.
Individual security detail archetype with live/delayed data and chart.
Mutual-fund category archetype; checks a second investment-product template.
Primary public interactive task; calculator inputs/results plus repeated-interaction memory test.
Account-opening/sign-up journey up to the credential boundary; tests modal, form, consent, and reversibility.
Editorial listing archetype; represents content discovery and article-card presentation.
Invalid-route recovery state; represents HTTP/navigation failure handling.

findings.summary: Dark mode ignores the user preference
findings.evidence: The dark-condition screenshot remains white and the rendered root is data-theme="light" with color-scheme:light.
findings.suggestedFix: Add an early color-scheme meta, set :root { color-scheme: light dark }, and drive semantic color tokens with prefers-color-scheme/light-dark().

findings.summary: Reduced-motion users still receive indefinite motion
findings.evidence: The preference matched, but five animations remained, including four indefinitely running 30s–200s animations, and no reduced-motion CSS rule was found.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap non-essential marquee/hero animations in no-preference and stop auto-running motion under reduce.

findings.summary: Route changes are abrupt despite View Transition support
findings.evidence: The browser supports View Transitions, but no view-transition CSS was present on any representative template and route changes use abrupt full swaps.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-document navigation with document.startViewTransition and add cross-document @view-transition where compatible.

findings.summary: Long-page navigation chrome does not adapt on mobile
findings.evidence: Long pages retain a clipped desktop-style header and provide no progress or scroll-state adaptation; no scroll-state/container CSS was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Make header/ticker responsive and use CSS scroll-state/container queries for compact scrolled chrome with a fallback.

findings.summary: Navigation does not cue moved focus or direction
findings.evidence: Route changes and the 404-to-home path provide no directional transition or focus/attention cue; view-transition/highlight styles were absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Use directional view transitions and move focus to the destination heading after route/error recovery.

findings.summary: Account page is obscured by an unsolicited signup overlay
findings.evidence: The demat route opens with a viewport-covering signup overlay before interaction and no visible close action.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep account information visible and open signup only after an explicit action; always provide a visible dismissal.

findings.summary: Signup modal is a non-semantic fixed DIV
findings.evidence: The covering signup modal is a fixed DIV (.rodal) with no dialog role; representative pages reported zero <dialog> and zero popover elements.
findings.suggestedFix: Replace the Rodal DIV with <dialog>, declarative closedby/light-dismiss behavior, labelled heading, and focus restoration.

findings.summary: All representative mobile templates overflow horizontally
findings.evidence: Every sampled template overflowed horizontally: home/stocks/mutual funds by about 6.7k px, stock detail by 442 px, calculator by 384 px, demat by 347 px, and blog by 682 px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove fixed desktop widths, constrain ticker tracks without inflating document scrollWidth, and use intrinsic/fluid sizing at narrow viewports.

findings.summary: Shared components do not adapt to their containers
findings.evidence: No @container rules were found, while shared header/ticker and cards visibly remain desktop-sized and clipped at mobile widths.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container-type on reusable shells/cards and @container rules where each component is reused at narrow widths.

findings.summary: Hundreds of targets are undersized and keyboard focus is unreliable
findings.evidence: Each template exposes more than 400 visible targets below 24px in at least one dimension; sampled pre-rendered anchors did not accept focus or show an outline.
findings.suggestedFix: Give interactive targets at least 24x24 CSS px (prefer 44px for primary touch controls), remove hidden tabbables, and add clear :focus-visible styles.

findings.summary: Mobile performance misses the Core Web Vitals load bar
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured LCP 10.6s, TBT 7,020ms and performance 0.33; trace corroborated LCP 2.44s and 445ms TBT in a lighter desktop run.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the LCP asset/content, defer non-critical code, and profile INP/TBT contributors before shipping.

findings.summary: Long tasks block the main thread
findings.evidence: Trace recorded 9 long tasks (longest 232ms, TBT 445ms); mobile Lighthouse measured 7,020ms TBT.
findings.suggestedFix: Break app initialization into scheduler-yielding tasks and defer analytics/widgets until after core interactivity.

findings.summary: The home load ships 360 requests and 4.14MB
findings.evidence: Home loaded 360 requests and 4.14MB transferred, including 138 scripts; Lighthouse failed LCP discovery and network-dependency insights.
findings.suggestedFix: Shorten critical chains, preload only true LCP dependencies, cache static assets, and conditionally load non-critical integrations.

findings.summary: At least 776KiB of JavaScript is unused on load
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimated 776KiB unused JS and 16KiB unused CSS; analytics and app chunks dominate the request weight.
findings.suggestedFix: Code-split by route/interaction, remove duplicate analytics clients, and load large optional dependencies on demand.

findings.summary: Controls and links lack robust accessible names
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found an accessible-name mismatch; calculator has three unlabeled inputs, the account overlay input has no label/ARIA name, and image audit found two missing alt attributes.
findings.suggestedFix: Add explicit labels to calculator/signup inputs, repair label/name mismatches, and give meaningful images/links accurate alternatives.

findings.summary: Key ticker and CTA colors fail contrast
findings.evidence: Ticker text measured 2.51:1, positive values 2.66:1, and the white-on-green Get started control 2.66:1, below WCAG AA.
findings.suggestedFix: Use darker semantic text/accent tokens that reach 4.5:1 for normal text and verify all interactive states.

findings.summary: Landmarks and focus orientation are weak
findings.evidence: Representative probes found no main/nav/header/footer landmarks, while sampled links had outline-style none and many empty accessible names, making focus orientation unreliable.
findings.suggestedFix: Add semantic header/nav/main/footer landmarks, remove empty links, preserve logical focus order, and style :focus-visible.

findings.summary: Zoom is disabled and content fails mobile reflow
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse found a second viewport declaration with maximum-scale=1/user-scalable=no; every template overflowed horizontally and hundreds of targets were under 24px.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove maximum-scale/user-scalable restrictions and fix intrinsic reflow so content works at 320px and 400% zoom.

findings.summary: The page logs runtime, FedCM, and CSP errors
findings.evidence: Console logged FedCM concurrency/network errors and multiple CSP-blocked scripts, images, and analytics requests.
findings.suggestedFix: Deduplicate credential requests and align third-party initialization with the deployed CSP; keep production console clean.

findings.summary: Image dimensions and delivery are inconsistent
findings.evidence: Doctype/charset are valid, but 4 images lack dimensions, 29 are oversized, 18 use legacy formats, and 2 lack alt text.
findings.suggestedFix: Reserve image space, provide responsive srcset/sizes, and right-size/modernise below-fold images.

findings.summary: BFCache, source maps, and inspector hygiene regressions remain
findings.evidence: The page failed BFCache for three no-store reasons, emitted inspector issues, and large first-party bundles referenced missing source maps.
findings.suggestedFix: Review no-store usage, publish correct source maps to the error tracker, and clear DevTools inspector issues.

findings.summary: Hundreds of links have no descriptive text and mobile zoom is blocked
findings.evidence: URLs and robots are crawlable, but 326–330 anchors per template have no descriptive text/accessible name, and mobile Lighthouse found zoom disabled by a second viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Do not render empty navigation anchors; ensure every crawlable link has meaningful text and retain a single scalable viewport meta.

findings.summary: Cookie and CSP policy is inconsistent across variants
findings.evidence: HTTPS/HSTS/nosniff/frame protection are present, but the desktop response lacked CSP, 7 of 8 cookies were flagged insecure, and the mobile CSP blocked several configured integrations.
findings.suggestedFix: Set Secure/SameSite intentionally on all cookies and deploy one tested nonce/hash-based CSP consistently across desktop/mobile.

findings.summary: Tracking and third-party collection is heavy by default
findings.evidence: Load contacted 14 third-party origins including four known trackers; HAR captured 347 third-party-classified requests and 4.07MB transferred (including first-party asset subdomains classified by origin).
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise analytics vendors/events, delay consent-sensitive tags, batch telemetry, and document each third party’s purpose.

findings.summary: Referrer and Permissions policies are absent
findings.evidence: Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy are absent; desktop CSP was absent while mobile CSP produced blocked-resource violations, indicating inconsistent defensive policy deployment.
findings.suggestedFix: Add restrictive Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy, then align CSP and frame-ancestors across response variants.

findings.summary: Installable metadata has no offline service worker
findings.evidence: A valid standalone manifest exists, but navigator.serviceWorker.getRegistrations() returned no registration, so the app has no demonstrated offline fallback.
findings.suggestedFix: Register a small service worker with an explicit offline fallback and test flaky/offline navigation, or remove unsupported installability claims.

findings.summary: Multilingual/bidi readiness is not demonstrated
findings.evidence: Pages declare lang=en but no dir; the public site claims multilingual finance yet exposes no hreflang/language choice in sampled metadata, and severe fixed-width overflow gives no evidence that translated expansion or bidi layouts survive.
findings.suggestedFix: Expose language alternatives/hreflang, set direction where needed, use logical properties, and test translated expansion and RTL.

findings.summary: Account opening starts with an undismissible commitment UI
findings.evidence: The demat route forces an undismissible full-screen signup DIV before users can inspect the page; there is no visible cancel/close affordance and consent copy is compressed into the continuation UI.
findings.suggestedFix: Let users review the offer before signup, make dismissal/cancellation obvious, and separate consent links from the primary CTA.

findings.summary: Signup validation lacks semantic, accessible error handling
findings.evidence: The signup control is not a semantic form, its text input is unlabeled, and no accessible error-announcement surface or declarative validation semantics were present.
findings.suggestedFix: Use a real form, labelled email input, post-interaction validation, aria-invalid, and a live error summary.

findings.summary: Inputs do not expose purpose-specific autofill semantics
findings.evidence: The signup field has autocomplete="on" instead of a purpose-specific email token and no label/ARIA name; three calculator inputs are also unlabeled.
findings.suggestedFix: Use autocomplete=email/username as appropriate and programmatic labels; label calculator ranges with output associations.

findings.summary: The account flow is not visibly reversible
findings.evidence: The account route immediately traps the page behind a modal-like signup layer with no visible cancellation, weakening reversibility before the user can review account details.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a clear close/back path before identity capture and keep pricing, terms, and cancellation information available.

findings.summary: Most images are oversized or delivered inefficiently
findings.evidence: 29 of 31 images were over 2x displayed resolution, 18 used legacy formats, 7 lacked srcset, and 26 below-fold images were not lazy-loaded.
findings.suggestedFix: Generate responsive AVIF/WebP variants, supply srcset/sizes, lazy-load below fold, and right-size decorative assets.

findings.summary: Background scripts and requests waste client resources
findings.evidence: The home load makes 360 requests with 138 scripts; Lighthouse estimated 776KiB unused JS and the trace recorded nine long tasks.
findings.suggestedFix: Deprioritise background fetches, conditionally initialize analytics, and stop idle work when hidden.

findings.summary: Third-party scripts consume a disproportionate budget
findings.evidence: Known ad/analytics trackers and WebEngage contribute hundreds of kilobytes; Google Tag Manager/gtag alone account for roughly 487KB transferred.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a vendor byte/request budget, remove duplicate Google tags, and defer WebEngage/ads until justified by consent and intent.

findings.summary: A simple calculator has a large baseline heap/DOM footprint
findings.evidence: A simple calculator retained about 833k heap nodes and 49.9MB self size at baseline, a large footprint for this surface even though it did not grow under repetition.
findings.suggestedFix: Reduce pre-rendered global navigation/hidden links and route bundles; measure heap/DOM after each reduction against this baseline.

taskList.title: Restore mobile reflow and zoom across the shared shell
Cut LCP/TBT by route-splitting and deferring analytics/widgets
Make account opening explicit, semantic, dismissible, and reversible
Repair labels, landmarks, focus, link names, and contrast
Deploy consistent secure headers and privacy-minimised telemetry
Add and test an offline fallback
